detail.description: @fastify/busboy 是一个多部分表单数据解析器。在版本 3.1.0 到 3.2.0 中，未经身份验证的远程攻击者可以通过发送边界被设计为特定长度的多部分请求来阻止 Node.js 事件循环。供应商的流式搜索将其跳跃表存储在固定的 256 个条目字节数组中，并且正好 252 个字节的边界使搜索针变为 256 个字节，这将默认的跳跃距离截断为零，并将搜索变成小型主体上的 CPU 绑定循环。单个小请求可能会使一个核心繁忙，并拒绝为同一进程处理的其他请求提供服务。该问题已在 @fastify/busboy 3.2.1 中得到修复，它加宽了跳跃表，因此保留了跳跃距离。用户应升级到3.2.1。

detail_original.description: @fastify/busboy is a multipart form-data parser. In versions 3.1.0 through 3.2.0, a remote unauthenticated attacker can stall the Node.js event loop by sending a multipart request whose boundary is crafted to a specific length. The vendored streaming search stores its skip table in a fixed 256 entry byte array, and a boundary of exactly 252 bytes makes the search needle 256 bytes, which truncates the default skip distance to zero and turns the search into a CPU bound loop on a small body. A single small request can keep one core busy and deny service to other requests handled by the same process. The issue is fixed in @fastify/busboy 3.2.1, which widens the skip table so the skip distance is preserved. Users should upgrade to 3.2.1.
